statements.text: An IAM user can be a member of up to 10 IAM groups.
statements.explanation: Default IAM quota: a user can belong to up to 10 groups.

statements.text: IAM roles have long-term access keys assigned to them.
statements.explanation: Roles use short-term credentials delivered via STS, not long-term access keys.
Boundaries only set the MAX permissions a policy can grant — they don't grant anything themselves.

statements.text: IAM policies are global resources, not regional.
An explicit Deny in any attached policy overrides every Allow.
statements.explanation: Standard IAM policy-evaluation logic: explicit Deny wins.
